methods.name: Gaussian mixtures (Full, Tied, Diagonal, Spherical as VVV, EEE, VVI, VII)
methods.reference: mclust::Mclust(G = 3, modelNames = VVV, EEE, VVI, VII); tight fixed points of mclust::mstep/estep
methods.tolerance: EM_PARAM 1e-5 relative, EM_LOGLIK 1e-12 relative (tight fixed points), FIXED_POINT 1e-10 relative from the tight values; df and classification exact. Differences from mclust in the doc: k-means start, relative_change stopping rule (iteration counts not pinned), relative ridge and a warning for a singular covariance where mclust reports NA.
